articles.summary: BlueLinx Holdings Inc. (NYSE: BXC), a leading U.S. wholesale distributor of building products, will issue second quarter 2026 financial results after the market closes on Tuesday, August 4, 2026. A conference call to discuss the Company’s results will be hosted by Shyam Reddy, President and Chief Executive Officer, and Kelly Wall, Senior Vice President, Chief Financial Officer and Treasurer, on Wednesday, August 5, 2026, at 10:00 AM ET.
